scope: synthetic supplied-model decision sensitivity, not invention validation
nominal: maximize independent success at interval midpoint; menu-order tie break
robust: maximize arbitrary-dependence success minimum over rectangular marginal ranges; menu-order tie break
report: all 18 Cartesian cases, exact values, robust-minus-nominal differences on both metrics, all losses/ties/wins
expectations: Robust cannot lose on its own optimized worst-case objective by construction; this is not superiority evidence. It may lose on nominal objective. No tuning after scoring.
